confirm.description:
Add {name}?

This integration only reads the collar's status (bark, howl and whine counts, battery, mode and settings). It never sends a command to the collar.

user.description: Choose a Dogtra SMART NOBARK collar. Only collars currently in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy are listed. If the Dogtra phone app is open, the collar is connected to the phone and will not appear -- close the app first.

abort.no_devices_found: No Dogtra collar found. Make sure it is switched on, in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy, and that the Dogtra phone app is closed.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a Dogtra SMART NOBARK collar.
